outcome.status: No confirmed material defect in the assigned scope.
outcome.false_pass_assessment: An early return based on screen bounds alone does not create a required layout pass: control/text callers also check the real containing surface and finite full-frame containment; failed assertions terminate this test.
conditional_limits: Reveal operates against app bounds rather than the exact containing surface. It could stop early then fail the independent containment assertion if a future surface is smaller; not reproduced in the current iPhone workflow.

Drag x=0.97 of app width is not guaranteed to fall within a centered iPad sheet. App targets iPhone/iPad, but required CI destination is iPhone; no iPad runtime result or confirmed product defect claimed.

The loop has 12 observations and up to 12 drags, with no final observation after the twelfth drag. A target first becoming visible on that last drag could produce a false failure; no current required control was shown to need that boundary.
